description:
Record a usage event. Idempotent on event_id (safe to retry — never
    double-billed). outcome is 'ok' or 'error' and feeds the SLA report.

event_id.description: Your id for this usage event; recording it again never double-bills.
event_id.title: Event Id

metadata.description: Optional. Extra key-value data stored with the record.
metadata.title: Metadata

meter_id.description: The meter id returned by create_meter.
meter_id.title: Meter Id

outcome.description: ok or error. Feeds the SLA report.
outcome.title: Outcome

name: record_usage
title: Record usage
